lines.beaver: 어서 오십시오. 오늘은 어떻게 해 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Welcome. What can I do for you today?
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo osipsio. oneureun eotteoke hae deurilkkayo?
lines.en: I'd like my curly hair straightened a bit.

lines.beaver: 요즘 신경 많이 쓰시네요. 무슨 계기라도 있으세요?
lines.beaver_en: You've been taking care lately. Any reason?
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum singyeong mani sseusineyo. museun gyegirado isseuseyo?
lines.en: I heard looks matter in interviews too.

lines.beaver_en: Were you worried about first impressions?
lines.learner: 인상이 어두워 보인다는 말을 자주 들었어요.
lines.en: People often said I looked gloomy.
lines.roman: insangi eoduwo boindaneun mareul jaju deureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How was it at the interview?
lines.learner: 깔끔해 보이려고 머리와 옷차림부터 정리하고 갔어요.
lines.en: I tidied up my hair and outfit first so I'd look neat.
lines.roman: kkalkkeumhae boiryeogo meoriwa otcharimbuteo jeongnihago gasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: So that's why you got into beauty care.
lines.learner: 네, 모발 관리부터 하고 걸음걸이도 고쳤어요.
lines.en: Yes, I started with hair care and fixed my walk.
lines.roman: ne, mobal gwallibuteo hago georeumgeorido gochyeosseoyo.

lines.en: They say walking proudly is attractive, even if small.

lines.beaver: 요즘 손님처럼 외모에 신경 쓰시는 분이 많아요.
lines.beaver_en: A lot of people pay attention to their looks these days, like you.
lines.beaver_roman: yojeum sonnimcheoreom oemoe singyeong sseusineun buni manayo.
lines.learner: 친구는 쌍꺼풀 성형을 하려는지 병원을 알아보더라고요.
lines.en: My friend is looking into clinics, as if she's going to get double eyelid surgery.
lines.roman: chinguneun ssangkkeopul seonghyeongeul haryeoneunji byeongwoneul arabodeoragoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Have you thought about it too?
lines.learner: 저는 지금 제 눈도 충분히 괜찮은 것 같아요.
lines.en: I think my eyes are fine as they are.
lines.roman: jeoneun jigeum je nundo chungbunhi gwaenchaneun geot gatayo.

lines.beaver_en: That's right. Your eyes are really pretty.
lines.en: I'm no beauty, but I've gained confidence now.

lines.beaver_en: There, all done. It suits you well.
lines.learner: 머리가 정말 마음에 들어요! 또 올게요.
lines.en: I really love my hair! I'll come again.
lines.roman: meoriga jeongmal maeume deureoyo! tto olgeyo.
